question_types_in_exam.summary: RBSE Class 12 Chemistry mein 6 types ke questions: MCQ (0.5), Fill Blank (0.5), VSA (1), Short (1.5), Long (3), Essay (4). Total = 56 marks.

types.how_to_attempt: Sirf correct option (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) likhna hai. No explanation. 0.5 mark ke liye time waste mat karo.
types.mostly_from: IUPAC names, definitions, formulas, reaction types, electrode reactions, rate law, coordination compound nomenclature, organic compound identification.

types.how_to_attempt: One word/formula/chemical name/value likhna hai. IUPAC names, constants (Kc, Ea), reagent names.
types.mostly_from: Chemical formulas, IUPAC names, constants, specific reagents (Lucas reagent, Fehling's solution etc.).

types.how_to_attempt: Definition, formula, or 1-2 sentence answer. Equation likhna bhi acceptable.
types.mostly_from: Definitions (Molarity, EMF, rate of reaction), conditions (SN1/SN2), identify reagent, write reaction product.

types.how_to_attempt: Concept + example + reaction/equation. 1.5 marks = definition/concept (0.5) + equation/formula/example (1).
types.mostly_from: All 10 chapters — short derivations, numericals (1-2 steps), named reactions, mechanism (small), comparison questions.

types.how_to_attempt: Full explanation with equations/mechanism/structure. 3 marks = concept (1) + equations/steps (1.5) + result/conclusion (0.5).
types.mostly_from: Standard derivations — Nernst equation, integrated rate law, reaction mechanisms, named reaction with mechanism, coordination compound isomerism.

types.how_to_attempt: Complete topic explanation with all reactions, mechanisms, structures. 4 marks = introduction (0.5) + reactions/mechanism (2.5) + conclusion/application (1).

paper_pattern.note: RBSE Chemistry theory paper = 56 marks. 4 sections. ~52 questions. Duration: 3 hours 15 minutes (15 min reading time extra).
paper_pattern.internal_choice_note: Section C (Long Answer) aur Section D (Essay) mein internal choice (OR option) milta hai.

difficulty_distribution.note: Organic chemistry (Ch 6-9) Section C aur D mein thodi mushkil hoti hai. Physical chemistry (Ch 1-3) mein numericals scoring hain.

important_diagrams_masterlist.note: Named reactions masterlist — asked directly in MCQ/Fill Blank/VSA. Chemistry equivalent of diagram list.

must_practise.diagram_name: Wurtz reaction — Na in dry ether → Alkane (higher)
Fittig reaction — Na in dry ether → Diphenyl
Wurtz-Fittig reaction — Na in dry ether → Alkylbenzene
Sandmeyer reaction — CuCl/CuBr + HCl/HBr → ArX from diazonium salt
Gattermann reaction — Cu powder + HCl/HBr → ArX from diazonium salt
Lucas test — ZnCl2 + conc. HCl → Distinguish 1°/2°/3° alcohols
Victor Meyer test — PI3 → HNO2 → NaOH → Distinguish 1°/2°/3° alcohols
Kolbe's reaction — CO2 + NaOH + pressure → Sodium salicylate from phenol
Reimer-Tiemann reaction — CHCl3 + NaOH → o-hydroxybenzaldehyde from phenol
Williamson synthesis — R-ONa + R'X → Ether
Aldol condensation — dil. NaOH → β-hydroxy carbonyl compound
Cannizzaro reaction — conc. NaOH → Disproportionation of aldehydes without α-H
Rosenmund reduction — H2/Pd-BaSO4 → Aldehyde from acyl chloride
Clemmensen reduction — Zn-Hg + conc. HCl → Reduces C=O to CH2
Wolf-Kishner reduction — N2H4 + KOH + ethylene glycol → Reduces C=O to CH2
Hell-Volhard-Zelinsky (HVZ) — Cl2/Br2 + red P → α-halogenation of carboxylic acid
Tollens' test (Silver mirror test) — [Ag(NH3)2]+ (Tollens' reagent) → Silver mirror — distinguishes aldehyde from ketone
Fehling's test — Fehling's solution A + B (Cu2+) → Brick red ppt — distinguishes aldehyde
Gabriel phthalimide synthesis — Phthalimide + KOH + RX → Primary amine
Hofmann bromamide reaction — Br2 + NaOH → Primary amine with one less C
